EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-15-2016 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BOGDAN, TAD ALAN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PARRO, RICHARD $3,879.10 PRINCIPAL, $150.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,029.10, PLAINTIFF'S REMEDY IS AGAINST DEFENDANT'S TENANT FOR TENANT'S NEGLIGENCE IN THE ABSENCE OF PROOF OF NEGLIGENCE ON BEHALF OF THE OWNER/LANDLORD. HOWEVER, APPLICABLE CC&RS REQUIRE THAT OWNERS MAINTAIN INSURANCE TO COVER DAMAGE TO ANOTHER OWNER'S UNIT. THEREFORE, DEFENDANT MUST IMPLICATE HIS OWNERS' INSURANCE TO COVER PLAINTIFF'S LOSS OR COVER THE LOSS HIMSELF. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT PARRO, RICHARD
